<!-- pr-reviewer: 8a9b80e9a66f9fecb88f31af70a06b82da33f01c -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Thanks for this, @mkinney.

**What looks good**
- `SetRibbonPins` (`crates/app/src/commands/ribbon_pins.rs`) records prev/next, cleans the list as `pinned_set` does, refuses a no-op at creation, and `invert` restores the previous list. It matches the Everything Is a Command law.
- No unwrap/expect/panic and no unchecked indexing in the new code. `toggle_pin` (`panes.rs`) names a refusal in the status line instead of swallowing it.
- Layering is respected (ui calls the app command). No new components, no dependencies, and no build.rs, scripts, workflow or CHANGELOG changes.
- Provenance line present. The body has a `Changelog:` line, ends `Fixes #143`, and the commit subject is conventional.
- Tests pin the behaviour: an app-level apply/undo/redo/no-op test, UI gesture tests, and an updated old-behaviour test.

**Local results (PR trial-merged with current main; the merge was clean)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test ribbon` | 10 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`) | 238 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The PR body says 11 tests in the `ribbon` suite; I count 10 on merged main (the new test is present). This is probably just a count drift.
- The `is_dirty()` assertion can follow once #141 lands, as you proposed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
